newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen opening sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen opening sharply lower.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to fall heavily at Wednesday's opening, pressured by reports and rumours that questioned the recent strength of blue chips and technology stocks.

Analysts said the market, which has shown resilience following a sharp sell-off last Friday, would be tested once more by rumours that International Business Machines Corp was about to issue a profit warning.
A column in Wednesday's Wall Street Journal in addition questioned whether Japanese institutions were losing their appetite for U.S. Treasuries.
